 Your Role
 As a Senior Python Developer with Capgemini, you will play a key role in the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of scalable software solutions. You will leverage your extensive experience in Python development to deliver high-quality applications, drive technical excellence, and contribute to architectural decisions. Working within a complex ecosystem, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build reliable, secure, and high-performing solutions that meet business needs.
 In this role you will:
Design, develop, maintain, and optimize software applications and services using Python and related frameworks, following established architecture and development standards.
Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable, maintainable, and efficient software solutions.
Develop and integrate APIs, microservices, and backend components while ensuring seamless interoperability with internal and external systems.
Create, execute, and maintain automated unit, integration, and performance tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
Participate actively in software architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions and technology selection.
Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and promote best practices related to performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and DevOps initiatives to optimize software delivery processes.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture, API specifications, deployment procedures, and operational guides.
Mentor junior developers, support knowledge-sharing initiatives, and contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices.
Collaborate closely with architects, business analysts, project managers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
 Your Profile
Minimum 8 years of overall IT experience and at least 5 years of professional Python development.
Excellent knowledge of Python and modern development frameworks such as Django, Flask, FastAPI, or similar.
Proven experience developing RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed applications.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software design principles, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
Experience with asynchronous programming, performance optimization, and scalable application design.
Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL) and ORM frameworks.
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Redis, or Cassandra is considered an asset.
Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks (PyTest, UnitTest), code quality tools, and software development best practices.
Experience with source control systems (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform) is considered a strong asset.
Knowledge of message brokers and event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, etc.) is an advantage.
Ability to analyze complex technical requirements and propose innovative, scalable solutions.
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
Experience working in Agile and international, multicultural environments.
Excellent communication skills in French and English.
